microstepsPerStep.description: Microstep subdivision.  Total counts per turn = ``stepsPerTurn × microstepsPerStep``.

motorListIndex.description: Index of the device in the XIMC-enumerated motor list.  ``0`` for the first detected device.

stepsPerTurn.description: Full motor steps per 360° (e.g. 200 for a 1.8°/step motor).

ximcLibLocation.description: Filesystem path to the bundled XIMC vendor library.  Often a network drive — if the path becomes unreachable the manager falls back to the mock.
